verdict.rationale: Galileo's release notes explicitly describe organizing sessions, traces, and spans into queues for structured review by subject matter experts to scale human feedback, and the product overview mentions capturing SME annotations — directly matching the story. However, this is only a brief release-note mention with no detailed docs, API/SDK reference, or independent corroboration on how to configure or manage these annotation queues. Missing for 10: dedicated how-to documentation on setting up/routing to annotation queues, SDK/API reference for the feature, and independent/hands-on confirmation.
